topic.title: Using Web Author with a File Repository
topic.shortdesc: Overview of how to access and use with supported file repository integrations.

body.p: When you open , the Dashboard provides actions for accessing XML files stored in various file repositories. Depending on the repository you choose, follow the instructions shown on the screen. This section includes information about using with Git (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps), WebDAV, SharePoint Online, Perforce Helix, IBM Content Navigator, and other file storage services through a generic CMIS connector. These repository integrations are provided through plugins, and your system administrator must enable and configure the appropriate plugin before you can access the repository.
